about.title: What is Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
paragraphs: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is an action-adventure game developed by Asobo Studio and published by Focus Entertainment, released on August 27, 2026 — a prequel to A Plague Tale: Requiem. You play as Sophia, a young plunderer who braves the trial-ridden Minotaur Island in search of the lost treasure her late father chased.

The game reinvents the formula: dynamic melee combat replaces stealth-heavy encounters, and light-reflection puzzles reach new heights. As Sophia descends, she experiences flashbacks to the Minoan era — living the brutal trials of the legendary hero Theseus across a dual timeline spanning 2,000 years, closing in on the very origins of the Macula.

trailer.title: Official Launch Trailer
